series.name: PV-2200 / PV-5200 / Infineon Reborn (1.5–4.2KW hybrid)
series.notes: Image-only PDFs — troubleshooting table read via pdftoppm (p34 PV-5200). Subset of Voltronic-class codes (absence ≠ no such code). Medium (image read, single source). PV-2200 and PV-5200 share table family.

causes.en: Dust/bearing
causes.ur: Dhool jama hona ya bearing kharab hona

causes.en: Fan bearings worn out from dust and long use.
causes.ur: Dhool aur lambi use se fan ki bearing ghis jana.

causes.en: Fan connector loose or the fan wire broken.
causes.ur: Fan ka connector dhila ho jana ya fan ki taar toot jana.

solutions.en: Switch off the AC and PV supply and wait about 5 minutes before opening the unit.
solutions.ur: Unit kholne se pehle AC aur PV supply band karke 5 minute intezaar karein.

solutions.en: Remove the cover, blow the dust out of the fan and spin the blade by hand; if it is stiff, noisy or the bearing is worn, replace the fan.
solutions.ur: Cover kholein, fan ki dhool nikaal dein aur pankha haath se ghumayein; pankha azaadi se na ghoome, awaaz kare ya bearing ghis jaye to fan badal dein.

solutions.en: Refit the cover, restore power and run the inverter to confirm the fan turns freely and the fault does not come back.
solutions.ur: Cover wapas lagayein, power on karein aur inverter chalakar confirm karein ke pankha theek ghum raha hai aur fault dobara nahi aaraha.

meaning.ur: Converter ka temperature bohat zyada ho jana

causes.en: Vents
causes.ur: Vent block ho jana

causes.en: Vents blocked with dust or the unit sits in a hot closed space.
causes.ur: Vent dhool se band ho jana ya unit garam band jagah par lagi ho.

causes.en: Cooling fan stopped or the heatsink is full of dust.
causes.ur: Cooling fan band ho jana ya heatsink dhool se bhar jana.

solutions.en: Power off the inverter and let it cool down before touching any part.
solutions.ur: Pehle inverter band karein aur thanda hone dein, phir kisi bhi part ko haath na lagayein.

solutions.en: Clear the vents, remove dust from the heatsink and make sure the cooling fan is free to turn.
solutions.ur: Vent saaf karein, heatsink se dhool hataayein aur confirm karein ke cooling fan asani se ghum raha hai.

solutions.en: Restore power and check that the temperature falls and the fault clears; if it comes back, have the unit checked by a technician.
solutions.ur: Power wapas on karein aur dekhein ke temperature kam ho raha hai aur fault khatam ho raha hai; wapas aaye to technician se unit check karwaein.

causes.en: Type/qty
causes.ur: Battery type ya tadad ghalat hona

causes.en: Charge voltage setting higher than the connected battery can take.
causes.ur: Charge voltage setting battery ki sehath se zyada set ho jana.

causes.en: Battery old or sulphated so it stops accepting charge.
causes.ur: Battery purani ya sulphated ho jana is liye charge lena band kar de.

solutions.en: Check battery type/qty vs program settings and terminal tightness
solutions.ur: Battery type/qty program setting se milayein aur terminals tight karein

solutions.en: Power off; do not keep restarting — technician/repair centre required
solutions.ur: Band karein; baar baar restart na karein — technician/repair centre zaroori

causes.en: Load short
causes.ur: Load mein short hona

causes.en: Short inside the connected load or appliance wiring.
causes.ur: Lagay hua load ya appliance ki wiring mein short ho jana.

causes.en: Output wiring loose or damaged and shorting to the body.
causes.ur: Output wiring dhili ya tooti hui ho jis se body mein short aa jaye.

solutions.en: Treat DC terminals as live even with breakers off
solutions.ur: DC terminals ko live samajhein, chahe breaker off ho

solutions.en: Power off; do not keep restarting — technician/repair centre required
solutions.ur: Band karein; baar baar restart na karein — technician/repair centre zaroori

causes.en: Grid/output
causes.ur: Grid ya output theek nahi hona

causes.en: Grid voltage sitting outside the allowed window.
causes.ur: Grid voltage allowed window se bahar chala jana.

causes.en: Loose output connection or a faulty output relay.
causes.ur: Output connection dhila ho jana ya output relay kharab ho jana.

solutions.en: Switch off the inverter and do not keep restarting it; treat the DC side as live until it is isolated.
solutions.ur: Inverter band karein aur baar baar restart na karein; DC side isolate hone tak usay live samajhein.

solutions.en: After isolating the supply, measure the grid and output voltage with a meter and confirm both sit inside the normal window.
solutions.ur: Supply alag karke, meter se grid aur output voltage naapein aur confirm karein ke dono normal window ke andar hain.

solutions.en: Check the input/output terminals and wiring for looseness or damage; if the voltage is still outside the window, stop and send the unit to a repair centre.
solutions.ur: Input/output terminal aur taarain check karein ke kahin dhila ya toota to nahi; voltage phir bhi window se bahar ho to ruk jayein aur unit repair centre bhejein.

meaning.ur: Load 110% ya us se zyada hone par timer khatam.

causes.en: Heavy load
causes.ur: Bohat zyada load hona

causes.en: Motors or air conditioners started together as a heavy load.
causes.ur: Motor ya AC jaisa bhaari load ek saath chal jana.

causes.en: Load stayed above the inverter rating for a long time.
causes.ur: Inverter rating se zyada load lambi der chalta rehna.

solutions.en: Turn off or unplug high-power loads before restarting the inverter.
solutions.ur: Inverter restart karne se pehle bhaari load band karke nikaal dein.

solutions.en: Check the total load with a clamp meter and keep it below the inverter rating; start motors and heavy appliances one at a time.
solutions.ur: Clamp meter se total load check karein aur rating se neeche rakhein; motor aur bhaari appliance ek ek karke chalayein.

solutions.en: Restart the inverter and confirm it keeps running without the overload timer tripping again.
solutions.ur: Inverter restart karein aur confirm karein ke overload timer dobara trip nahi ho raha.

meaning.ur: DC bus ka voltage bohat zyada ho jana

causes.en: Internal
causes.ur: Andaruni hissa kharab hona

causes.en: PV or battery input voltage higher than allowed.
causes.ur: PV ya battery input voltage allowed se zyada ho jana.

causes.en: Internal sensing or snubber parts failed so the bus is uncontrolled.
causes.ur: Andaruni sensing ya snubber part kharab ho jana jis se bus control mein na rahe.

solutions.en: Power off and isolate both the AC and DC sources; do not keep restarting the unit.
solutions.ur: Power band karke AC aur DC dono source alag karlein; unit baar baar restart na karein.

solutions.en: With the supply isolated, measure the DC input with a meter and check that the PV/battery voltage is in range and every DC terminal is tight.
solutions.ur: Supply alag honay ke baad, meter se DC input naapein aur check karein ke PV/battery voltage range mein hai aur har DC terminal tight hai.

solutions.en: If the bus still trips on over-voltage, the internal circuit needs a technician or repair centre — do not open the cover yourself.
solutions.ur: Phir bhi bus over-voltage par trip ho to andaruni circuit technician ya repair centre ke hawale karein; khud cover na kholein.

causes.en: Precharge
causes.ur: Precharge circuit kharab hona

causes.en: Precharge resistor or relay failed so the bus does not charge slowly.
causes.ur: Precharge resistor ya relay kharab ho jana jis se bus aahista aahista charge na ho.

causes.en: DC input missing or too low at start-up.
causes.ur: Start-up par DC input na aaye ya bohat kam ho.

solutions.en: Switch off and isolate the AC and DC supplies before any probing.
solutions.ur: Koi bhi checking se pehle AC aur DC supply band karke alag karlein.

solutions.en: Use a meter to check the DC input terminals, precharge path and relay/contactor connections for looseness, burn marks or a failed precharge resistor.
solutions.ur: Meter se DC input terminal, precharge ka raasta aur relay/contactor connection check karein ke koi dhilapan, jala hua nishan ya kharab precharge resistor to nahi.

solutions.en: Power up again; if the soft start still fails, stop and hand the unit to a repair centre instead of restarting it repeatedly.
solutions.ur: Dobara power on karein; phir bhi soft start fail ho to ruk jayein aur baar baar restart ki jagah unit repair centre dein.

meaning.ur: Over current ya surge ki wajah se trip hona

causes.en: Load surge
causes.ur: Load mein achanak surge aana

causes.en: Sudden heavy load or motor inrush current.
causes.ur: Achanak bhaari load ya motor ka inrush current.

causes.en: Output wiring shorted or a part failed on the output side.
causes.ur: Output wiring short ho jana ya output side ka part kharab ho jana.

solutions.en: Power cycle: AC off → 2–5 min → on (DC isolated for DC work)
solutions.ur: Power cycle: AC band → 2–5 min → on (DC kaam ke liye alag)

solutions.en: Power off; do not keep restarting — technician/repair centre required
solutions.ur: Band karein; baar baar restart na karein — technician/repair centre zaroori

meaning.ur: DC bus ka voltage bohat kam ho jana

causes.en: Battery/PV
causes.ur: Battery ya PV ka voltage kam hona

causes.en: Battery voltage low or battery fully discharged.
causes.ur: Battery voltage kam ho jana ya battery mukammal discharge ho jana.

causes.en: PV input missing or the DC connection loose.
causes.ur: PV input na aaye ya DC connection dhila ho jana.

solutions.en: Power cycle: AC off → 2–5 min → on (DC isolated for DC work)
solutions.ur: Power cycle: AC band → 2–5 min → on (DC kaam ke liye alag)

solutions.en: Power off; do not keep restarting — technician/repair centre required
solutions.ur: Band karein; baar baar restart na karein — technician/repair centre zaroori

source.title: Fronus PV-5200 4.2KW hybrid product manual (image PDF — troubleshooting table read via pdftoppm p34)

causes.en: Output stage
causes.ur: Output stage kharab hona

causes.en: Output relay or contactor not picking up.
causes.ur: Output relay ya contactor pick na karna.

causes.en: Load connected at start-up too heavy or already shorted.
causes.ur: Start-up par lagaya hua load bohat bhaari ho ya pehle se short ho.

solutions.en: Power off and isolate the AC and DC supplies before opening the inverter.
solutions.ur: Inverter kholne se pehle AC aur DC supply band karke alag kar dein.

solutions.en: Inspect the output stage wiring, relay and filter parts for loose connections or burnt marks, and use a meter to confirm the output is not shorted.
solutions.ur: Output stage ki wiring, relay aur filter part dekhein ke koi dhila ya jala hua to nahi, aur meter se confirm karein ke output short nahi hai.

solutions.en: Restore the supply and retry the soft start; if it fails again, the output stage needs technician or repair centre service.
solutions.ur: Supply wapas on karke soft start dobara try karein; dobara fail ho to output stage ka kaam technician ya repair centre karega.

source.title: Fronus PV-5200 4.2KW hybrid product manual (image PDF — troubleshooting table read via pdftoppm p34)

title.en: Over DC offset in AC output
title.ur: AC output mein DC offset bohat zyada

causes.en: Output stage
causes.ur: Output stage theek na chalna

causes.en: Output stage transistor or driver fault.
causes.ur: Output stage transistor ya driver kharab ho jana.

causes.en: Filter capacitor degraded or output wiring loose.
causes.ur: Filter capacitor kamzor ho jana ya output wiring dhili ho jana.

solutions.en: Disconnect the AC load and isolate the supplies before taking any measurement.
solutions.ur: Naapnay se pehle AC load alag kar dein aur supply isolate karlein.

solutions.en: Measure the DC offset on the AC output with a meter and inspect the output wiring, relay contacts and filter capacitor for damage or loose joints.
solutions.ur: Meter se AC output par DC offset naapein aur output wiring, relay contact aur filter capacitor ko damage ya dhila joint ke liye dekhein.

solutions.en: If the offset stays, stop using that output and send the inverter to a repair centre for output stage repair.
solutions.ur: Offset barqarar rahe to output istemal band karein aur inverter output stage ki marammat ke liye repair centre bhejein.

source.title: Fronus PV-5200 4.2KW hybrid product manual (image PDF — troubleshooting table read via pdftoppm p34)

causes.en: Sensor
causes.ur: Current sensor kharab hona

causes.en: Current sensor connector loose or sensor wire broken.
causes.ur: Current sensor connector dhila ho jana ya sensor ki taar toot jana.

causes.en: Sensor itself failed or damaged by heat.
causes.ur: Sensor khud kharab ho jana ya garmi se damage ho jana.

solutions.en: Power off and isolate the supplies before opening the unit.
solutions.ur: Unit kholne se pehle power band karke supply alag kar dein.

solutions.en: Check the current sensor plug and wiring for looseness or breakage, then measure the sensor reading with a meter and compare it with a normal reading.
solutions.ur: Current sensor ka plug aur taar check karein ke koi dhila ya toota to nahi; phir meter se sensor ki reading naapein aur normal reading se compare karein.

solutions.en: If the reading is missing or wrong, replace the sensor or its board — this is a technician job — and retest the inverter afterwards.
solutions.ur: Reading na aaye ya ghalat aaye to sensor ya uski board badlein — yeh technician ka kaam hai — phir inverter dobara check karein.

source.title: Fronus PV-5200 4.2KW hybrid product manual (image PDF — troubleshooting table read via pdftoppm p34)

causes.en: Grid/output
causes.ur: Grid ya output voltage kam hona

causes.en: Grid voltage below the allowed window.
causes.ur: Grid voltage allowed window se neeche chala jana.

causes.en: Weak or loose output connection.
causes.ur: Output connection kamzor ya dhila ho jana.

solutions.en: Switch off the inverter and isolate the supply; do not keep restarting it.
solutions.ur: Inverter band karein aur supply alag karlein; baar baar restart na karein.

solutions.en: After isolation, measure the grid and output voltage with a meter and check the input/output terminals, wiring and grid connection for looseness or damage.
solutions.ur: Alag karne ke baad, meter se grid aur output voltage naapein aur input/output terminal, wiring aur grid connection ko dhilapan ya nuksan ke liye check karein.

solutions.en: If the output stays below the window, stop and hand the unit to a technician or repair centre.
solutions.ur: Output phir bhi window se neeche rahe to ruk jayein aur unit technician ya repair centre dein.
